messages:
Maria Nunez: FYI egress firewall tighten rolled to eu-west ~1h ago. Audit log buffering spiked and several GPU warmpool joins failed to prewarm (stuck in provisioning). S3 put throttle errors from logshipper. @Ajay please investigate.
Ajay Patel: Looking. 503s from log-collector -> s3 proxy, conntrack high on NATGW. Firewall change added default-deny outbound to audit cluster; we allowed collector LB but proxy is on different ENI.
Devon Chen: Runtime: 8 join attempts timed out waiting for audit ack in last 15m. Warmpool evicted after 2m -> cold starts. First-token latency ~+120ms p50 for warmups.
Ethan Cole: If this persists 24h, rough estimate ~18% extra GPU hours and ~22% token-cost increase for affected routes. S3 retry egress a few hundred USD.
Lucy Park: Security note: tightened a /22 to deny unknown outbound. If we open an exception for proxy ENI we must record it in audit allowlist with a short-lived justification.
Ajay Patel: Adding temp egress allow for ENI eni-0a1b2c3d and whitelisting proxy CIDR for 1h to let backlog drain. Also bumping conntrack on NATGW.
Devon Chen: Flip warmpool prewarm timeout from 10s -> 60s for eu-west to avoid premature eviction.
sre-bot: [alert] eu-west: warmpool prewarm failures +9x since firewall rollout. Runbook #wg-boot-02 triggered.
Ajay Patel: Commands run: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-auditshipper --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.12.34.0/24 --description "temp allow log-proxy eni"
Maria Nunez: Logs trickling, backlog present. How to avoid future incidents?
Lucy Park: Propose per-region dependency manifest for audit endpoints and gate firewall rollouts with e2e check validating logshipper->S3 and proxy health. Auto-rollback on failure.
Devon Chen: Add a CD test: post a small event to audit stream and wait for S3 object (signed URL) within 30s; fail deploy if missing.
Ethan Cole: Also improve warmpool degrade path: prefer reduced capacity over many cold starts; implement a budgeted fallback ramp.
Maria Nunez: Actions: 1) let backlog drain (Ajay) 2) revert firewall in eu-west and re-roll with manifest + e2e (Lucy) 3) tune warmpool fallback (Devon) 4) cost estimate & finance notify (Ethan).
Ajay Patel: Backlog draining, errors down to single digits. Temp rule to stay ~45m then close.
Devon Chen: Pushed lenient prewarm. Adding per-region metric for audit-ack latency to alert before eviction threshold.
sre-bot: [info] Temporary firewall rule added: sg-auditshipper -> allow 10.12.34.0/24:443.
deploy-bot: Rollout egress-tighten-v2 -> eu-west FAILED health-check; automatic pause engaged.
Maria Nunez: Thanks. Please @channel update when firewall fully rolled back. :thumbsup:
